title: Dad Won't Open My PRESENT 🎁
premise: In our town a wrapped present is whatever you hope it is until it is opened, so nobody opens anything. My dad has kept one box wrapped on his mantel for twelve years, and it has grown heavy enough that something inside it walks.
twist: I gave Dad an empty box when I moved out at eighteen. For twelve years it held the one thing he hoped for, me coming home, so when he finally opens it, it is empty because what he hoped for is standing in his doorway.
world: A sunny small-town house: butter yellow walls, a white mantel with a round numberless clock, a blue armchair, a porch with five white steps and a blue rail, a mint kitchen, and the neighbours' porches.
